When there's no real way to know what was going through a guy's head when he died, medical examiners error on the side of telling families what they want to hear. Suicides are probably still under-reported, but less so than they were 50 years ago.

My theory is that people are going crazy at a higher rate.

I believe the constant stream of media (steady flow of lies) is forcing people brains to short circuit as their subconscious sees a different reality than what is being forced on them.
